mapper.select: SELECT * FROM monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics WHERE monitor_sys_gen_server_id = #{serverId} ORDER BY monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_collect_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_cpu_usage) as avg_cpu_usage, MAX(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_cpu_usage) as max_cpu_usage, MIN(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_cpu_usage) as min_cpu_usage, AVG(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_memory_usage) as avg_memory_usage, MAX(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_memory_usage) as max_memory_usage, MIN(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_memory_usage) as min_memory_usage, AVG(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_disk_usage) as avg_disk_usage, MAX(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_disk_usage) as max_disk_usage, MIN(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_disk_usage) as min_disk_usage, COUNT(*) as data_points FROM monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics WHERE monitor_sys_gen_server_id = #{serverId} AND monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_collect_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_collect_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') as time_point, AVG(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_cpu_usage) as cpu_usage FROM monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics WHERE monitor_sys_gen_server_id = #{serverId} AND monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_collect_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_collect_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') ORDER BY time_point ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_collect_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') as time_point, AVG(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_disk_usage) as disk_usage FROM monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics WHERE monitor_sys_gen_server_id = #{serverId} AND monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_collect_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_collect_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') ORDER BY time_point ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_collect_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') as time_point, AVG(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_network_in) as network_in, AVG(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_network_out) as network_out FROM monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics WHERE monitor_sys_gen_server_id = #{serverId} AND monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_collect_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_collect_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') ORDER BY time_point ASC

AVG(monitor_sys_gen_server_metrics_cpu_usage) as metric_value
